SELECTED_INDEX: 9
CONFIDENCE: 0.34
EXPLANATION: The experimental spectrum is dominated by aliphatic C–H stretches (3004, 2972, 2933, 2879 cm⁻¹) and shows a weak, broad O–H stretch at 3309 cm⁻¹ (rule GFQ-001), indicating at least one hydroxyl group. Mid-IR/Raman bands at 1247, 1226, 1137 and 1026 cm⁻¹ match the typical C–O–C and C–O stretching region of aliphatic cyclic ethers/acetals, while strong bands at 826, 880 and 759 cm⁻¹ are characteristic ring-breathing / C-O-C deformation modes of dioxolane/dioxane systems. Among the candidates, only molecule 9 (OCC1(C2CCO2)CO1) contains both an –OH group and a bicyclic acetal with two ring oxygens, providing the required O–H and multiple C–O stretches. Candidates lacking –OH (1,2,4,8) cannot explain the 3309 cm⁻¹ band, and those containing N–H (3,6,10) should exhibit NH bending near 1600 cm⁻¹, which is absent. Candidate 5 contains Br (expected C–Br band ~600 cm⁻¹, not observed). Candidate 7 has no O or OH. Therefore, candidate 9 best matches the observed O–H stretch and the pattern of ether C–O vibrations and ring modes.
